answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents at random; each must answer in 60 seconds with proof from its ferrous hardware, unfakeable by software clones. Two misses slash a 40 POA deposit locked 20 epochs and mark the identity saffron. Forging 1,000 agents costs 1,000 machines plus 40,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool. Honest agents pay once, anchor to hardware, and keep earning.
